evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Institute of History and Philology Museum
evidence.text: The museum reads oracle-bone 年 as 禾 above 人, a person carrying grain, and interprets it as a good harvest. It cites the paired Shang divination questions 我受年 and 我不其受年. The passage supports an early harvest sense and a pictorial interpretation; it does not establish 人 as a phonetic component.
evidence.kind: institutional paleographic account with transcribed inscription
evidence.title: 我受年──甲骨文「年」的故事

evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Center for Digital Cultures / Chinese Character Database
evidence.text: The database calls harvest 年’s original meaning; it describes oracle-bone and bronze forms as 禾 above 人 and says small-seal lower 人 changed into 千. This is the database’s graphic-history account; no dated sequence of glyph images was independently examined here.
evidence.title: 漢字「年」：字形演變

evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: The entry reports the Shuowen analysis “从禾，千聲” and glosses harvest, followed by year, New Year, age, period, and life-stage senses with classical citations. This records a historical lexicographic analysis and later sense documentation; it does not confirm the earliest graph’s composition or establish a complete chronology among those senses.
evidence.title: [A01194] 年 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: Chinese University of Hong Kong, Multi-function Chinese Character Database
evidence.field: 形義通解: graphic history, sound analysis, and oracle/bronze uses
evidence.text: The entry presents a disputed analysis: early graph is person bearing grain, with 人 said by cited scholars to contribute both meaning and sound; it reports later graphic alteration toward 千 and notes the small-seal 千聲 analysis. It gives oracle-bone 受年 as harvest and cites an oracle-bone phrase 貞自今十年又五 interpreted as fifteen years, while cautioning that this reading is conditional. It also reports Western Zhou bronze inscriptions using 年 for years. These are source-reported analyses and readings, not independently re-edited inscriptions here.
evidence.kind: scholarly character-database entry with cited inscription interpretations
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫: 年

evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Chinese Character Database / Xiaoxuetang guide
evidence.text: The guide says the database includes oracle-bone, bronze, Warring States, small-seal, and clerical forms and provides links to character-specific evolution records. This establishes the database’s stated scope, not the 年-specific form labels. The character-specific Xiaoxuetang query was unavailable in this run.
evidence.title: 小學堂新手入門

evidence.field: File description, source attribution, original-file link and reuse permission
evidence.text: The file description identifies the image as a modern vector depiction of 年 in Shang oracle-script style, points to Xiaoxuetang record 42.F100 (甲2827 合27941), and states CC0 1.0 for the Sinica database image and public-domain status for the representation. It is a redraw, not an artifact photograph. The page provides an exact Original file link, but the image server rejected inspection as unsupported SVG content; the verified URL is retained as a candidate for downstream acquisition.
evidence.title: File:年-oracle.svg

search_audit.query: 年 甲骨文 形义 收年 禾 人 小学堂 字形演变
search_audit.outcome: Opened Academia Sinica museum and character-database pages. Museum supports the harvest interpretation and gives a transcribed oracle-bone divination pair; the database reports a human-to-千 graphic change.

search_audit.query: 年 oracle bone inscription harvest 年 Xiaoxuetang glyph record CC0
search_audit.outcome: Opened the museum page and exact Commons file description. Xiaoxuetang query was unavailable; Commons identifies a specific Sinica source glyph and CC0, but fetching the original SVG image returned unsupported content type.

search_audit.query: 年 字形 年 金文 小篆 说文 从禾千声 异体字典
search_audit.outcome: Opened Taiwan Ministry of Education variant dictionary; it reports Shuowen’s 禾 plus 千 phonetic analysis and later senses. Search results also located the CUHK character account, which was opened for disputed phonetic analysis and cited inscription uses.

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: 年 character oracle bone bronze 年 image
search_audit.outcome: Inspected exact Commons descriptions. 年-oracle.svg directly identifies 年 and provides source and reuse provenance. The bronze file description was found but its page fetch failed with cache miss; unrelated artifact photographs were not selected.

gaps: Early harvest use is directly supported by an institutional account, but the path from harvest to recurring year, calendar year, New Year, age, and life-stage senses is not fully dated. CUHK presents the grain-cycle-to-year link as likely and cites a possible Shang time-count example while explicitly making that reading conditional; later dictionary senses alone do not supply a chronology.

Whether 人 also served as a phonetic component in the early graph remains disputed. CUHK reports scholars’ dual semantic/phonetic account; the museum supports the pictorial person-carrying-grain account but does not establish phonetic function. The available exact Baxter–Sagart row is for 年 only and cannot establish sound correspondence with 人 or 千, so no sound component is asserted.

The Sinica character database reports the lower element’s change from 人 to 千; CUHK gives a more detailed account of variants. The sequence was not independently checked against a dated run of inspectable glyph images. Shuowen’s 千聲 analysis is a historical lexicographic statement, not proof of the original graphic formation.
The supplied local kMandarin row 年 = nián was checked, but the official Unicode U+5E74 record was inaccessible. No phonetic component has been established, so no component sound array is offered.

The character-specific Xiaoxuetang query was unavailable and returned no supplied candidate forms. The selected Commons file description links a specific Xiaoxuetang form and rights notice, but the original SVG request could not be inspected because the browser rejected its content type. It remains a sourced candidate; downstream acquisition may still fail.

The exact local Baxter–Sagart row was supplied and preserved as *C.nˤi[ŋ], MC nen. No external source for the exact local table row was verified. The citation URL in that local row’s metadata is a failed Unihan page and does not substantiate Baxter–Sagart.
